Name: Hub
Tagline: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions like 5
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Open-source dispatcher for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Write a goal in your browser or Telegram, a coordinator hands it to agents, and only the decisions come back. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. One-line install. Experimental: agents run without permission prompts.

Name: ExtraOrbital
Tagline: ✦ Open bar databases, storage buckets & AI keys for agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Vibe coding
Description: Your app needs databases, storage, caching, AI keys, and more. That's dozens of accounts, API keys, invoices, and backups to manage. Agents can't stand it. They don't even have access. You feel like their credentials go-fetch puppet. ExtraOrbital reads yourenv.example file and creates all these ressources for you. It's a CLI, so your agents can use it. They don't even need an account. You gain back control, increase security and manage everything in a central dashboard. Bye bye,env hell !

Name: Remora
Tagline: The long-term memory layer for AI agents
Description: Remora is continuous memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest conversations, deduplicate facts, and recall relevant context in under 15ms. Powered by PostgreSQL + pgvector with native Python & TypeScript SDKs. Stop re-inventing memory tables.

Name: Monton
Tagline: AI agents that do your agency's busywork
Description: Monton is agency management software with AI agents built in. Agents watch budgets, chase overdue invoices, write client reports and remind people about missing hours, on your real hours, staffing, billing and CRM data. Pick one of 18 templates or describe it in a chat. Every email waits for your approval. AI is included in every paid plan: no credits, no per-seat pricing. Free up to 5 people.

Name: Ground
Tagline: Related synthetic tables where every key and total holds
Description: Ground turns a one-sentence description into related synthetic tables where every key, total and rate holds, or extends a dataset you already have. One sentence produced 72,365 rows with 0 orphan keys; asked for ~5% overdue, it delivered 5.03%. Use it in the browser, via API, or from Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT through its MCP server.

Name: OpenChat
Tagline: Open-source live chat in your own Cloudflare account
Topics: Android, Open Source, Customer Communication, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Customer chat for your website that runs in your own Cloudflare account, so conversations stay with you. A 2 KB widget in 11 languages, a team inbox on web, iPhone and Android with end-to-end encrypted notifications, a help centre, and an optional AI assistant that answers first and hands over to a person. Open source and self-hosted, with one-click deploy.

Name: Kagi Mail
Tagline: Private email that puts people who need you first
Description: Kagi Mail is a private email service designed to help you focus on what matters. Its intelligent inbox highlights people waiting for your reply, identifies emails that need action, and keeps newsletters and unwanted messages out of the way. Ask questions about your inbox, organize emails using natural-language rules, and use unlimited aliases and custom domains. No ads, no tracking, no profiling. Includes 50 GB storage and a built-in calendar, with open standards and no vendor lock-in.

Name: QA.tech MCP
Tagline: Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: QA.tech MCP gives Claude Code, Cursor or Codex an external QA agent to check their work. It runs E2E tests on what each change does to your product and finds the bugs and edge cases your coding agent missed, so they get fixed before the PR goes to review. Stay in your IDE: QA.tech explores your app, writes the tests and runs them. Your coding agent reads the results and fixes what broke. Works with any MCP client. New to QA.tech? One prompt maps your app and kicks off your first test.

Name: Upsolve Harness 2.0
Tagline: A data agent that's 2x faster and learns every user
Description: We rebuilt our agent harness from scratch for people who don't know the data. Twice as fast, self-correcting SQL, custom skills for your analyses, suggestions that improve it over time, and memory that personalises every user.

Name: Clary
Tagline: iOS notifications in sender's own voice from WhatsApp & more
Description: Clary reads your iPhone notifications in the sender's own voice, from WhatsApp, iMessage and more. It uses voice cloning: each person records 20 seconds once, from a link, and agrees first, then Clary makes their voice on your iPhone. Tap a message to hear it in their voice, so you feel closer to your people. It also keeps your notifications as a history on your iPhone, sorted Gmail-style into Messages, Updates and Promotions. Free: history, sorting and 2 plays. Needs iPhone 15 Pro+ and iOS 27.

Name: Nookdeck
Tagline: Turn your old phone into a Stream Deck for your computer
Description: Nookdeck turns an old phone or tablet into a touch control panel for your Mac or Windows PC. A small app on the computer serves the panel to the phone's browser over Wi-Fi: no app to install on the phone, no account, no cloud. Old iPhones on iOS 12 work too. Buttons for shortcuts, apps, media and macros; live tiles for system stats, Now Playing and weather; Home Assistant controls; Claude and Codex usage; plugins and theme packs. Free and open source (MIT).

Name: iwantmy.app
Tagline: Describe a mobile app in chat and open it on your phone
Description: Tell iwantmy.app what your app is for and who uses it. About a minute later it runs on a phone, with accounts, staff roles, bookings with places left, photos, maps and group chat built in. Ask for changes in chat; each one goes live when it is done, and a failed change leaves the app as it was. Open your app from its link or QR code in the phone's browser, or in our test app for iPhone and Android. Free plan: 1 app and 30 AI changes a month, no card.

Name: Pax by Pydantic
Tagline: A coding agent where even coding is a plugin
Description: Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal. Every part is a plugin, it runs any model, and --agent runs your own Pydantic AI agent in it.

Name: Doodle
Tagline: The stick figure on your taskbar that answers questions
Description: Doodle is a little AI companion that lives on your Windows taskbar. Ask it anything with Ctrl+Shift+Space, or dictate into any app. When it can't do something, Doodle Evolution builds a bespoke plugin, shows you what it can reach, and waits for your OK.

Name: DeskFleet
Tagline: Run coding agents together across your team’s machines
Topics: Android, Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: DeskFleet gives your team a shared session with the coding agents you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor where your code lives. A teammate can join from their laptop, review the diff, approve the next command, or take control of the remote desktop. Your tools and agent credentials stay on the machine doing the work.

Name: Superframes
Tagline: Brief an AI Director to edit the whole video
Topics: Social Media, Artificial Intelligence, Photo & Video
Description: Superframes is an AI video editor with a Director inside. Give it a brief and it plans the edit, cuts it on a real timeline and lists each change, so you can undo one or all of them. It turns one long video into a board of captioned Shorts, and it generates the clip, voice or music you are missing. Editing runs on your device and your video files are never uploaded. Browser, Mac and Windows. Free to start, no account.

Name: Postmaster of Puppets
Tagline: See if anyone can send email as your domain
Description: Type a domain and see whether anyone can send email as it, from its SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, with the DNS record that fixes most problems. Runs in your browser: no account, no cookies. Each rule cites its RFC or provider page. The engine is open source (MIT).

Name: WhipDesk
Tagline: Control AI coding agents from your phone
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: WhipDesk puts your whole dev machine in your phone's browser, built for babysitting AI coding agents. Answer Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Cursor when they get stuck, review the diff, and test what they built. Get alerts when an agent needs you, save one-tap prompts, and schedule a "resume" for when your session limit resets at 2 AM. Open source on both ends, end-to-end encrypted, free.

Name: Watch Reader
Tagline: Books and articles, read aloud on your Apple Watch
Description: Add books, articles and web pages on your iPhone, then leave it at home. The AI voice runs on your Apple Watch itself, so it reads to you with no signal. Morning news, 25 voices, free classics. Free to download, with 30 minutes of listening every day.

Name: Bifura
Tagline: See your website the way AI agents do
Description: AI assistants now read websites for your buyers. Bifura fetches your page the way AI crawlers do, shows what they get and get wrong, and lets you test fixes in a sandbox before you ship. Free Agent readiness score in under a minute, no signup.
